title: polypodium trichomanoides var. truncicola
intro: Polypodium trichomanoides var. truncicola, commonly known as Mountain Polypody, is a variety of the Polypodium trichomanoides plant species, which is a type of fern native to Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to support lung health and is believed to have various health benefits, such as acting as an expectorant to aid in cough relief and helping to reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Polypody include its anti-inflammatory and anti-asthmatic properties, which can help to alleviate respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
